page.overview:
What is The Dead Ends?

The Dead Ends is the sixth and the final dungeon in Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker.

"Of Countless Stars", an arrangement of the main Ultima Thule theme "Close in the Distance", plays at all times in The Dead Ends except during boss battles.

"On Blade's Edge" plays while fighting the Caustic Grebuloff and the Peacekeeper, while "Finality" plays during the battle with Ra-la.

Two of the three civilizations recreated in this dungeon are mentioned in Meteion's report. Ostrakon Okto was the star Meteion mentioned that had destroyed itself shortly after her arrival, and Ostrakon Deka-hepta is implied to be the last star she describes in her report, which lost the will to live after having discarded all sources of sorrow and finding no more joy in life. Ostrakon Hexi is not named nor hinted at in her reports.
